worldcombat.skill.poisongas.summary: Spray a low-lying cloud of poison gas at a chosen spot. Anyone it covers is poisoned, and while they stand inside the poison keeps being renewed; outside it runs its own course. Any fire in the cloud sets the whole thing off, burning everyone inside.
The gas is sprayed at a chosen spot within %1$s blocks and settles into a cloud of radius %2$s blocks.

The cloud lasts %1$s seconds and only reaches non-allies it can see inside it; it acts every 5 ticks and covers at most %3$s targets each time. Those it covers are poisoned for %2$s, losing health over time; while they stand inside the poison keeps being topped back up, and outside it runs out on its own. Poison and Steel types are not poisoned.

When fire or a burning body appears in the cloud, the whole cloud detonates once: every non-ally in it takes about %1$s fire damage and is burned for %2$s (losing health over time; Fire types cannot be burned). After that the cloud becomes a fire cloud: it no longer poisons and instead keeps burning those it can see inside.
worldcombat.skill.poisongas.use.0: Seal off a corridor or doorway
worldcombat.skill.poisongas.use.2: Drop a flame into the gas for a detonation
worldcombat.skill.poisongas.preference.d: On: a smaller cloud (radius x0.8) that lasts longer (x1.4), poisons longer (x1.4) and detonates harder (power x1.2) - good for sealing ground. Off: a wider cloud (x1.15) that is shorter (x0.8) and weaker, to blanket several targets at once.
worldcombat.skill.poisongas.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of spraying. Larger values chase harder and lay clouds out of reach more often.
When on, the user may leave its post to spray; when off, it only sprays at what it can reach from where it stands.
